sources.label: My Morphe patches and APK decompilation suite
sources.author: Aidan
patch_list: Applies a pure-black AMOLED palette to SidelineSwap's Compose theme: black surfaces and container tokens, readable light text and icons, a black launch window, light system-bar icons, and force-dark embedded WebViews.

Neutralizes first-party analytics (SidelineSwap backend), behavioral tracking (Amplitude, Firebase Analytics, Iterable), diagnostic telemetry (Firebase Crashlytics), payment gateway telemetry (Braintree FPTI), Google Play Install Referrer,…
Customizes the primary brand accent color across SidelineSwap buttons, navigation highlights, badges, and accents.
Removes the Invite Friends entry from the Account screen and blocks direct and deep-link navigation to the referral screen.
